DETERMINATION OF AREAS OF AGRARIAN DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 51 OFAGRARIAN DEVELOPMENT ACT, No. 46 OF 2000

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 51 of Agrarian Development Act, No. 46 of 2000, I, M. A. S.Weerasinghe, Commissioner General of Agrarian Development determine, that the area of the Authority of AgrarianService Committee 19/28 Nagampaha Agrarian Service Committee in the Galnewa Divisional Secretary’s Division in theElectorate Anuradhapura in Anuradhapura District published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1132/7 dated 16th May2000 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka should be amended as referred to in the following Schedule.
M. A. S. WEERASINGHE,Commissioner General of Agrarian Development.Department of Agrarian Development,No. 42, Sir Marcus Fernando Mawatha,Colombo 07,17th March 2016.
